rounds.text: Sudal Industries Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its sector peers, with a price-to-book ratio of 1.12x compared to the sector benchmark of 2.13x [E6]. This valuation is further supported by the stock trading at a price-to-book ratio of 1.07x, which is nearly equal to its book value of ₹ 28.5 [E1]. While the company has faced recent volatility, the medium-term trajectory shows a positive trend, with compounded profit growth accelerating to 25% over the last three years [E19]. This momentum is an improvement over the 14% growth seen over five years and the 6% growth over ten years, suggesting an underlying operational recovery [E17, E18]. Conceded: the company faces immediate headwinds, including a trailing twelve-month profit growth of -115% [E20], a negative ROE of -3.8% [E8], and a lack of dividend payments [E3]. Despite these challenges, the stock is currently positioned at the very bottom of its 52-week range, sitting only 3% above its low of ₹ 28 [E4].
